headline: Chaminade still without a point after six matches
dek: Chaminade lost at Hawai'i Pacific on Saturday, where they had already lost this month, and have now been beaten in all six matches they have played. They have scored three goals and conceded fifteen. Biola and Dominican (Calif.) are also without a win, but both have drawn.
displaced_by: standing lede no longer true (Concordia Irvine now seventeen goals, four wins); Chaminade's sixth defeat in six is the story

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Concordia Irvine's seventeen goals are more than Jessup, Hawai'i Hilo and Biola have scored together, yet they have conceded fifteen.

wire.line: Concordia Irvine won at Biola and now have more wins than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Point Loma drew with Westmont on Saturday and have three wins, three draws and two defeats, with fifteen goals scored and eleven conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day; the Vanguard matches that do have a score have brought one win, one draw and five defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Hilo have lost three matches in a row after opening with three wins; the defeat at MSU Denver leaves them with five goals scored and five conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Strickler has made 33 saves for Westmont and conceded thirteen goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jessup won at UC Santa Cruz on Saturday, their second win against one draw and four defeats, with six goals scored and twelve conceded.

last_match.line: Both of Hawai'i Pacific's wins this season have come at home to Chaminade.

next_match.line: Jessup won away on Saturday; Dominican (Calif.) have drawn as often as they have lost and are yet to win.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
